_: Plugins area: Plugins settings page, plugin setup (connect agent) page, connector automatic approval rules (standing policy) page and form, permission list.
Plugins.Title: Plugins
Plugins.Lead: Connect new capabilities. Review each package and its access grants before installation.
Plugins.Providers.Title: OAuth provider profiles
Plugins.Providers.Intro: Deployment administrator setup for providers declared by installed or pending connectors. Ordinary users connect their accounts through the connector's setup flow. Client secrets are encrypted and never returned to this page or to an agent.
Plugins.Providers.Note: Configuring credentials does not approve a package or grant an agent access. Every connector still requires explicit approval for its exact package and credential profile.
Plugins.Providers.ClientSecretHelp: Leave blank when editing to preserve the encrypted value.
_Plugins.Providers.ProfileMeta: {id} is the profile identifier; {kind} is the managed/self-hosted profile label.
Plugins.Providers.Error.SelectDeclared: Select a non-conflicting declared provider before saving credentials.
Plugins.Providers.Error.DeclarationChang: The provider declaration changed. Select it again before saving credentials.
Plugins.Providers.Saved: OAuth provider profile saved. The client secret is encrypted and will not be displayed again.
Plugins.Providers.Deleted: Provider profile and encrypted secret deleted.
Plugins.Import.Title: Import from GitHub
Plugins.Import.Intro: Use an exact 40-character commit SHA for reproducible imports. The manifest digest is shown before approval.
_Plugins.Import.PreviewHeading: {name} is the agent name, {kind} the plugin kind identifier.
Plugins.Import.Approve: I approve the displayed capabilities, permissions, publications, subscriptions, and network grants.
Plugins.Import.Installed: Plugin approved and queued for an isolated build.
Plugins.Installed.Title: Installed plugins
Plugins.Installed.Intro: Manage installed extensions and their runtime status.
Plugins.Installed.Empty: No plugins installed yet. Preview a package to get started.
Plugins.Installed.Removed: Plugin installation removed. Persistent provider data remains preserved for controlled cleanup.
PluginSetup.Lead: Connect your account securely. Your agent never receives your password or sign-in credentials.
PluginSetup.Cleanup.Pending: External access is disabled. Secure disconnection is still finishing; reconnect will be available afterward.
PluginSetup.Cleanup.Confirmed: The provider confirmed disconnection and local sign-in credentials were removed.
PluginSetup.Cleanup.Unconfirmed: Local sign-in credentials were removed, but provider revocation was not confirmed. Review the application's access in your provider account.
PluginSetup.Dependency.Title: Choose the account this agent can use
PluginSetup.Dependency.Intro: Access is granted only to the account you explicitly select. Changing accounts disables existing automatic-action policies.
PluginSetup.Dependency.NotInstalled: The required connection has not been installed for this organization. Ask an administrator to add it, then refresh this page.
PluginSetup.Dependency.OpensSeparately: Account setup opens separately. Return here when finished and refresh the choices.
PluginSetup.PermissionSummary: Permissions are granted to C-Sweet's secure connection broker. The agent never receives your provider password, OAuth token, or client secret.
PluginSetup.FindingAccounts: Finding accounts available through this connection…
PluginSetup.NoAccounts: No accessible accounts were found. Reconnect with the provider account that owns or manages the resource.
PluginSetup.AccountHelp: This connection will be bound to the account you confirm.
PluginSetup.HealthCheck: C-Sweet will verify the connected permissions and account binding before activation.
PluginSetup.DisconnectWarning: Disconnecting immediately disables external work, revokes authorization, and disables autonomous policies.
PluginSetup.DisconnectImpact: This stops account access for every linked agent and disables their automatic-action policies.
PluginSetup.Ready.Title: Ready to activate
PluginSetup.Ready.Intro: Activation enables the installation only after access and setup validation succeed.
PluginSetup.Ready.SelectAccount: Select a connected account above before activating.
PluginSetup.Connected: This installation is connected and ready. Use the settings steps above to manage permissions and preferences.
PluginSetup.Error.NoAccountChoices: The connected provider returned no account choices.
_PluginSetup.DefaultProvider: Fallback for the provider name in 'Connect {provider}' when the declaration has no display name.
PluginSetup.DefaultPermissionPurpose: Review and approve the requested provider permissions.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Title: Automatic approval rules
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Intro: Only a signed-in human organization owner can approve or revoke these rules. Connecting an account or choosing an approval preference does not grant standing authority.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.StoredPolicyHint: Execution still requires current account access, agent grants and matching rules. A stored approval alone does not prove current eligibility.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.AlwaysExplicit: This operation always requires an explicit decision. It cannot be enabled for automatic approval.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.LoadFailed: The review could not be loaded. Try again when the connection is available.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Saved: The policy was saved for eligible future requests in Fully Autonomous mode. The existing action still follows its own decision record.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.SaveUnconf: The result could not be confirmed. Retry this same approval or reload its status; no broader permission will be inferred.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Revoked: The policy was revoked. Future work requires current authorization; this cannot undo requests already sent.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.RevokeUnco: Revocation could not be confirmed. Reload or retry; do not assume that access is disabled until confirmed.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.SignIn: Sign in as a human organization owner to manage these rules.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.NotFound: This account-change review is no longer available.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.BadRequest: Check the field choices, schedule, expiry and limits before approving.
ConnectorStandingPolicy.Error.Changed: The account or policy may have changed. Reload and review its current state before trying again.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Warning: Matching future requests may change this account without an individual approval. These rules apply only to this agent in Fully Autonomous mode, not to other agents sharing the account. Other approval modes keep individual review. This does not approve the change already awaiting review.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Rule.Any: Allow other values within the operation's limits
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.MayBeUnset: May be left unset (the provider may apply defaults)
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.WindowHint: If the end time is earlier, the window continues into the next day. Selected days are the days the window starts.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.ExpiryTime: Expiry time in the selected time zone
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.MaxPerHour: Maximum automatically authorized actions per hour
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.EscalationTe: Require individual review when a request contains these words or phrases
One per line, up to 50. Matching ignores letter case; it does not understand meaning or replace human judgment.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.ScheduledFie: Scheduled publication or action time field (if this operation has one)
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.ScheduledHin: If selected, that time must also fit this policy's days, hours and lifetime. Account changes outside these limits require individual review.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.MediaHint: 1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes. The deployment's file limit and the operation's supported formats still apply.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Summary.AnyV: Other values are allowed within the operation's limits.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Summary.Maxi: {count, plural, one {Maximum: # action in any hour.} other {Maximum: # actions in any hour.}} Rate limits also apply when queued work starts.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Summary.Sche: Scheduled times in {label} must also fit these limits.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.FinalWarning: Permanent deletion and operations classified as sensitive, security-related or financial still need explicit decisions. Revoking these rules stops further authorization but cannot undo changes already sent.
ConnectorStandingPolicyForm.Authorize: I authorize matching future requests to change this account without individual approval.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Inco: Choose complete field rules, a valid expiry and an hourly action limit.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Dayl: That expiry falls in a daylight-saving clock change. Choose another time.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Expi: Choose an expiry within the next year.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Same: Choose different start and end times, or allow the whole day.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Medi: Choose at least one file type and a size limit no larger than 256 GB.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Inva: Choose a valid daily start and end time.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Rule: Choose a rule for every field.
ConnectorStandingPolicyEditor.Error.Valu: Choose permitted values for {label}, or explicitly allow it to be unset.
